scripts.start: concurrently "cd api-server && python app.py" "cd frontend-nextjs && npm run dev" "cd s3-reverse-proxy && npm start"
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd api-server && set FLASK_DEBUG=true && python app.py" "cd frontend-nextjs && npm run dev" "cd s3-reverse-proxy && npm run dev"
scripts.install-all: concurrently "cd api-server && pip install -r requirements.txt" "cd frontend-nextjs && npm install" "cd s3-reverse-proxy && npm install" "cd build-server && npm install"
